scope: TRAIN-only structural audit; no valid_unseen outcome was used

verified: Both preserved TRAIN logs contain six tasks covering all six ALFWorld task families and 294 steps per condition.
All 588 first decoded lines were non-empty and all retained a leading ReAct transcript marker.
All 588 exact commands sent to TextWorld retained that marker and all 588 returned Nothing happens.
Every recorded reward was zero and every done/won field was false; every episode reached the 49-action cap.
On the same reset, > go to fridge 1 was not admissible and returned Nothing happens.; go to fridge 1 was admissible and returned the real closed-fridge observation.
TRAIN-only replay of the already generated lines after removing exactly one marker recovered substantive feedback for 53 of 62 bare non-think steps and 50 of 62 RCMF non-think steps.

The pinned upstream ReAct notebook terminates the prompt with a transcript marker, strips its newline-stopped completion, sends that completion to the environment, and applies its think rule to action.startswith('think:').
inference: The preserved sanity rows establish no semantic action validity despite action_valid=true, because validate_text_action only checks non-emptiness.
The leading transcript marker is a structural prompt/action boundary defect, not evidence that Qwen, the prompt, or RCMF performs poorly.
The replayed sequences are not model outcomes because later actions were originally generated from a stuck Nothing happens. transcript.
unverified: Whether newly generated matched TRAIN trajectories under the corrected contract reach terminal success.
Whether either corrected complete valid_unseen arm succeeds on any task.
